content.content: 1. Necessity: the prose prerequisite leaves something only a machine-checkable artifact can settle — what counts as conforming — so the artifact cannot be dropped without loss. Fail if it could. 2. Fidelity, both directions: the artifact enforces exactly what the prose claims — no stricter, no looser, nothing smuggled in. Fail on divergence in either direction; name the diverging rule.
content.rationale: The entry's read of the working directory cannot be driven black-box — a child is spawned with a cwd — so the check is a read-through of the artifact's read against the fallback's claim.
